description: Defines the WorkShift entity class for the OrangeHRM system, with properties like id, name, hours per day, start time, and end time; includes ORM mapping and decorator traits.

classes.name: WorkShift
classes.description: Entity class representing work shift details such as name, hours per day, start and end times with ORM annotations and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the work shift.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the work shift.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the work shift.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Assigns a name to the work shift.

methods.name: getHoursPerDay
methods.description: Returns the number of hours per day for the shift.

methods.name: setHoursPerDay
methods.description: Sets the number of hours per day for the shift.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Gets the start time of the work shift.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the work shift.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Gets the end time of the work shift.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the work shift.
